pyramiding_rule: Strictly prohibit adding to positions unless the initial trade has moved at least +$8.00 in profit and volatility bands expand.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Require confirmation via a 3-period volume delta spike and an ATR-based buffer exceeding local micro-wicks before order execution.
profit_harvest_threshold: Scale out 50% at +$15.00 profit and trail the remaining position with a dynamic ATR stop until reaching +$30.00.
